question.text: A body of mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math> is initially at rest. It starts moving unidirectionally under the influence of a source of constant power <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math>. Its displacement in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><msup><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msqrt><mi>P</mi></msqrt><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> will be ______.

solution.text:
Energy provided will be used to increase kinetic energy of the body. Therefore,

12mV2=Pt

V=2Ptm

⇒dxdt=2Ptm⇒∫0xdx=2Pm∫04t12dt

⇒x=2Pm23t3204

⇒x=16P3=13×16P

Hence, required value of α=4.
